content:
name: Verify original-test evidence and enforce scoped parity

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: ['parity/**']
    paths:
      - tools/**
      - tests/**
      - compatibility/candidate-suites/**
      - compatibility/package-overlays/**
      - compatibility/evidence/**
      - .github/workflows/test-parity-ledger.yml
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - tools/**
      - tests/**
      - compatibility/candidate-suites/**
      - compatibility/package-overlays/**
      - compatibility/evidence/**
      - .github/workflows/test-parity-ledger.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: test-parity-ledger-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  infrastructure:
    name: Test inventory, observer and receipt validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install the CMake version used by the registration fixture
        run: python3 -m pip install cmake==4.4.4
      - name: Generate local site metadata required by existing tests
        run: python3 tools/prepare_site.py
      - name: Run infrastructure regressions, including real CMake configuration
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

  original-test-parity:
    name: Require declared native/browser obligations (${{ matrix.package }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: parity-evidence-checkout
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - package: base
            browser_matrix: unittest-browser-matrix-5.2-2026-10-23
            resource_matrix: unittest-browser-resources-5.2-2026-10-23
            context: runtime-context-2026-10-23
            path_map: ''
          - package: essentials
            browser_matrix: unittest-browser-essentials-5.2-2026-10-23
            resource_matrix: unittest-browser-essentials-resources-5.2-2026-10-23
            context: runtime-context-essentials-2026-10-23
            path_map: ''
          - package: source-build-codecs-sqlite
            browser_matrix: source-rebuild-unittest-39986612484/main
            resource_matrix: source-rebuild-unittest-39986612484/resources
            context: runtime-context-source-build-39986612484
            path_map: compatibility/evidence/source-rebuild-unittest-39986612484/path-map.json
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          path: parity-evidence-checkout
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Reconcile immutable original attempts and explicit resource retries
        env:
          PARITY_PATH_MAP: ${{ matrix.path_map }}
        run: |
          parity_map_args=()
          if [[ -n "$PARITY_PATH_MAP" ]]; then
            parity_map_args=(--path-map "$PARITY_PATH_MAP")
          fi
          python3 tools/reconcile_unittest_matrix.py \
            --repo-root . \
            --source-plan compatibility/evidence/unittest-native-5.2-2026-10-23/discovery-inventory.json \
            --native-retry-plan compatibility/evidence/unittest-native-resources-5.2-2026-10-23/resource-retry-inventory.json \
            --browser-matrix compatibility/evidence/${{ matrix.browser_matrix }}/matrix.json \
            --browser-matrix compatibility/evidence/${{ matrix.resource_matrix }}/matrix.json \
            --native-context compatibility/evidence/runtime-context-2026-10-23/native-context.json \
            --browser-context compatibility/evidence/${{ matrix.context }}/browser-context.json \
            --output evidence/reconciled-original-tests \
            "${parity_map_args[@]}" --report-only
      - name: Enforce the strict declared-scope gate
        run: >-
          python3 tools/test_parity_ledger.py
          --contract evidence/reconciled-original-tests/contract.json
          --inventory evidence/reconciled-original-tests/inventory.json
          --executions evidence/reconciled-original-tests/executions.json
          --evidence-root evidence/reconciled-original-tests
          --output evidence/reconciled-original-tests/strict-gate.json
      - name: Preserve blocked and passing reports alike
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: original-test-ledger-${{ matrix.package }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: parity-evidence-checkout/evidence/reconciled-original-tests/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
